Thinking about moving to Belton TX? In this video, we tour an incredible luxury home in Belton at 239 Eagle Landing Drive. With over 4,100 square feet, 5 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a resort-style pool and spa, outdoor kitchen, home theater, smart home technology, Tesla Powerwall, and solar panels, this property offers the perfect blend of luxury and efficiency.

You'll also learn why so many people are choosing to live in Belton TX, with easy access to Lake Belton, Fort Cavazos, Temple, Waco, and Austin. If you're searching for luxury homes in Belton TX, homes near Lake Belton, or considering a move to Central Texas, this tour is for you.

For more information about relocating to Belton, Temple, Waco, or the surrounding areas, contact us today and don't forget to subscribe for more Central Texas real estate tours and relocation guides.
